'''2026 Tweaking for Charity''' was a [[Players Committee]] charity event on [[GEMP]] for Go Red for Women, presented by [[Jared Greenwald]]. The event was six [[Tweak Set]] games, three Dark Side and three Light Side, on a 45-minute timer, from 10 March 2026 (or one day after the tweak set was fully live on GEMP) through 27 March 2026, with placement by strength of schedule.<ref name="t86504">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86504 2026 Tweaking for Charity], KrazyKarl, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 February 2026). Photograph: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1445985#p1445985 post 1445985], jetsaredim, 16 February 2026. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122230845/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1445985.html Internet Archive]</ref>

On 16 February 2026 [[Jared Greenwald]] posted a photograph of a signed [[Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith]] card, taken on 18 January 2026.<ref name="t86504" />

== Prizes ==

Registration was a $5 donation to the [[Players Committee]] or to the charity. Each registered player was to receive a physical and GEMP K-2SO, as an alternate image or a borderless treatment of the existing virtual card, and one GEMP AI Series 8 booster pack. First place was also to receive a Star Wars-themed t-shirt from Homage.<ref name="t86504" />

Players who completed all six games were in a random draw for a [[Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith]] card signed by David Prowse, donated by [[Jared Greenwald]], or a [[Grand Admiral Thrawn]] card signed by Timothy Zahn, donated by [[Karl Koenig]].<ref name="t86504" />
